name: MONSTRUM ACADEMIA
source:
MONSTRUM ACADEMIA is a Visual Novel that takes place in the modern day. The story follows the Sam, a newly high school graduate now ready to take on college life. After being denied entry to the Academy of their dreams, they are sent a letter from a mysterious sender known only by the name of Lindael. They read the letter and upon utter the words "Ire Monstrum Academia" they are swiftly teleported to somewhere different; Somewhere Unknown. 

[from [url=https://rosemarygames.itch.io/monstrum-academia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《MONSTRUM ACADEMIA》是一部发生在现代的视觉小说。故事讲述的是山姆，一名刚高中毕业的学生，​​现在准备开始大学生活。在被拒绝进入他们梦想的学院后，他们收到了一封来自神秘发件人的信，只知道他的名字叫林达尔。他们读了这封信，并在说出“Ire Monstrum Academia”这个词后，他们迅速传送到了不同的地方；未知的地方。

[来自[url=https://rosemarygames.itch.io/monstrum-academia]itch.io[/url]]
